reason: A quota monitoring plugin that queries configured provider APIs, measures local LLM usage, persists usage records, and presents quota and rate-limit status through sidebar cards and settings views.

summaries.zh: 监控多个 LLM 供应商的余额和限额，统计本地用量，并在侧边栏和设置页展示配额、成本与限流状态。
summaries.en: Monitors balances and usage limits across configured LLM providers, tracks local usage, and displays quota, cost, and rate-limit status in the sidebar and settings page.

capabilities: Queries configured external provider APIs for balance or usage data
Uses configured API key references and request headers
Collects and persists local token usage statistics
Executes user-configured JavaScript parsers or parser files
Displays quota, usage, cost, and rate-limit information in sidebar and settings UI
